headline: Lees-McRae and Francis Marion win on the road
dek: Francis Marion's win at Barton ended a run that had kept Barton unbeaten since September, and Lees-McRae won at Converse without conceding. Lees-McRae have won fifteen, lost once and let in nine goals all season; they host Francis Marion on Sunday.
displaced_by: Francis Marion beat Barton on 2026-11-06, so the standing dek's 'have not lost since September' no longer holds; Lees-McRae won at Converse the same night.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 50 goals have come from at least fifteen different scorers and have still brought five defeats; spreading the scoring has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: Lees-McRae, beaten once all season, host Francis Marion in the last match on the schedule.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, and every one of them is from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won fifteen matches, drawn two and lost four, and have conceded thirteen goals in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Conor O'Gorman has scored eleven goals and set up four for Lees-McRae, from 66 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Edouard Laberge has made 99 saves for Emmanuel and conceded 25 goals, a save percentage of .798.

last_match.line: Lees-McRae's first win over Converse this season, after the sides had drawn both earlier meetings.

next_match.line: Lees-McRae won October's meeting on this ground; Francis Marion have won every match since their October defeat at Barton.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
